t2e_check.ticket: T2e: parse anytime-TD market into expected TDs
t2e_check.command: ff.py --full trade --give "Trevor Lawrence" --give "Javonte Williams" --give "Drake London" --get "Justin Herbert" --get "Kenneth Walker III" --get "Rome Odunze" --projection-source market_anchor
t2e_check.conversion_method: General Poisson threshold solve (market_anchor._poisson_mean_for_threshold, reused from stat_distribution): P(Poisson(mu) > floor(line)) = market-implied P(over). At line 0.5 this is exactly the ticket's suggested closed form lambda=-ln(1-P); real live data instead posts line=1.5 (2+ TDs, verified against the raw SGO payload for every player checked), so the general root-find was used instead of hardcoding -ln(1-P), which would have understated expected TDs by roughly half. See STATUS.md's T2e Decision Log.
t2e_check.one_sided_market_finding: The anytime-TD market's paired 'under' oddID exists structurally in the raw SGO payload but its byBookmaker is always empty -- no book posts a genuine two-sided price. The single posted price's implied_probability is used as-is (no de-vig partner exists to remove the bookmaker's margin against), a stated simplification logged as a small systematic upward bias on the resulting lambda, not a claim of a vig-free probability.
t2e_check.scoring_source: Real league scoring_settings (rush_td=6.0, rec_td=6.0, confirmed equal); resolve_touchdown_scoring degrades to td_scoring_usable=False (no TD priced for anyone) if they ever differ or either is absent. Nothing hardcoded.
t2e_check.graceful_degradation: Verified separately by unit test (test_market_anchor.py ConvertSnapshotOptionalTdTests, test_market_anchor_projection.py test_t2e_td_absent_degrades_to_yardage_only_not_null): a player-week with required yardage complete but no posted anytime-TD market gets confidence='yardage_only', optional_missing=['td'], and a non-null yardage-only anchor_fp -- never null, never a fabricated TD value.
t2e_check.plausibility_check: Every one of the 6 players moved materially closer to the default (sleeper+espn) projection: t2d (yardage-only) 33%-56% of default -> t2e (yardage+TD) 54%-88% of default. t2f_check.ticket: T2f: multi-week blend fallback (market-anchored where priced, consensus elsewhere)
t2f_check.command: ff.py --full trade --give "Drake London" --get "Kenneth Walker III" --projection-source blend

before.note: T2e state: market_anchor_blend only had a week-1 entry per player; evaluate_trade needs weeks 2-17 (effective_week 2, since week 1 is in progress); _roster_average requires every week to resolve, so the average nulled even though the per-player week-1 anchor was real.

t2f_check.why_it_matches_default: The trade's effective week is 2 (week 1 already in progress), so the only anchored week (1) falls outside the evaluated range [2..17] for this specific trade. Every evaluated week is therefore a consensus-fallback week, and with an empty assumption registry T3's apply() is a no-op passthrough -- so 'blend' is mathematically identical to the existing sleeper+espn default for this trade. This is the correct, expected result given today's real market coverage (SGO only posts ~1 week of props ahead) and is not a sign the fallback did nothing: market_anchor_blend went from all-null (T2e) to a real 16-week series per player (T2f), and independent_projection_checks now reports it.
t2f_check.market_anchor_pure_still_null_by_design: independent_projection_checks['market_anchor'] (pure, no fallback) remains all-null for this trade, exactly as T2e left it -- required by the ticket's 'do not weaken existing independent_projection_checks; the new path is additive' rule. Only market_anchor_blend was extended.
